normalization_plan.reason: _from is only used to populate the TKN struct inside tokenFallback
_value is only used to populate the TKN struct inside tokenFallback
_data is unused calldata owned entirely by tokenFallback
the TKN memory struct is a transient local of tokenFallback
_customerAddress is a local alias used only for the spin event
_wagered is a local alias of the validated wager inside _spinTokens
the memory spin copy is read and rewritten only inside _spinTokens
the memory spin copy is only consumed while settling in _finishSpin
target identifies whose spin is settled and paid by _finishSpin
profit is computed and subtracted locally inside _finishSpin
result is derived and consumed locally inside _finishSpin
_wager is the sole input of the jackpot coverage check
maxProfit is a temporary product local to jackpotGuard
halfContractBalance is a temporary threshold local to jackpotGuard
blockn selects the blockhash entropy consumed by maxRandom
entropy is mixed into the hash computed by maxRandom
upper is the modulus applied by random
blockn is forwarded verbatim to maxRandom by random
entropy is forwarded verbatim to maxRandom by random
_tokenAmount is the only value written into validTokenBet
_newOwner is assigned directly to the owner state variable
_newBankroll is assigned directly to the bankroll state variable
_tokenContract is only compared against ZTHTKNADDR inside _zthToken
ZethrAddress is consumed by the constructor to set ZTHTKNADDR and ZTHTKN
BankrollAddress is consumed by the constructor to set the bankroll
